Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 2). CIMT is also managing the 
Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Moderate fire 
behavior with flanking, backing and single tree torching. Structures threatened. Area, road and trail closures in 
effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Moderate fire behavior with flanking, backing and single tree torching. Energy infrastructure 
threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
* West Coal Creek, Campbell County. Forty-five miles north of Gillette, WY. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Structures threatened. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
creeping, smoldering and single tree torching. Communication infrastructure threatened. Area closures in 
effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Communication infrastructure threatened. 
 
Rancher, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Two miles east of Evergreen, SD. Timber. Moderate fire behavior with 
smoldering. 
 
Post, Las Animas County. Seven miles southeast of Trinidad, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire 
behavior with smoldering and creeping. Last report unless significant activity occurs.
